answer.says: Ramesh, the air is too thick for a walk today. I shall rest in the study. Do not disturb me unless the house is on fire.
answer.thought: The plan for Lodhi Gardens is dead, buried under the haze and the exhaustion of the morning's writing. The body has its own logic, stubborn as stone; one cannot simply will the lungs to expand in this particulate soup. I shall sit in the cool of the study and let the mind wander without the burden of the street. It is a pause, a necessary negation before the next movement.
